properties.name: Atlanta
properties.lesson: Georgia’s capital and a major population, transportation, and economic center.

properties.name: Savannah
properties.lesson: A coastal city connected to Georgia history, the Savannah River, and maritime trade.

properties.name: Columbus
properties.lesson: A west Georgia city on the Chattahoochee River.

properties.name: Lake Lanier / Buford area
properties.lesson: A major reservoir area on the Chattahoochee system in north Georgia.

properties.name: Chattahoochee River study point
properties.lesson: Study how a river connects watersheds, drinking-water systems, recreation, cities, and downstream communities.

properties.name: Port of Savannah study point
properties.lesson: Use this location to study how ports connect Georgia to road, rail, warehousing, and global trade.

properties.name: Blue Ridge region study point
properties.lesson: Use this point as a gateway to study mountains, elevation, headwaters, and north Georgia communities.

properties.name: Piedmont region study point
properties.lesson: Study rolling uplands, major population centers, and the relationship between landform and urban development.

properties.name: Coastal Plain study point
properties.lesson: Study flatter terrain, agriculture, wetlands, rivers, coastal systems, and transportation corridors.
